scenario.name: Voice VLAN DHCP relay removed during config clean-up
scenario.description: A config clean-up on NYC-RTR-01 removes the DHCP helper on the voice sub-interface; phones that reboot after a firmware rollout cannot renew their address. The DHCP server sees nothing.

incident.title: New York desk phones stuck on 'Configuring IP' after firmware rollout
incident.description: After this morning's phone firmware rollout, New York desk phones reboot and stay on 'Configuring IP'. Desktops and laptops work normally. The telephony team blames the new firmware.

ground_truth.root_cause: During a config clean-up at about 09:57 UTC the DHCP helper 10.100.100.20 was removed from NYC-RTR-01 Gi0/0/1.20 (voice VLAN 20); DHCP requests from rebooting phones are no longer relayed to DC1-SRV-DHCP-01, so pool DHCP-NYC-VOICE receives no traffic.
